tasks.name: Build prospect list
tasks.description: List local businesses in a target niche/area with no site, an outdated site, or a site that fails mobile/speed checks; record name, contact, source, current URL
tasks.why: A pipeline of qualified leads is the only reliable source of projects
tasks.risks: Scraping personal data without basis; wasted time on poor-fit niches
tasks.common_mistakes: Listing everyone instead of a niche; no source tracking

tasks.name: Prospect mini-audit
tasks.description: Quick audit of prospect's site, Google Business Profile, socials: mobile view, speed, HTTPS, broken contact info; 3–5 concrete findings
tasks.why: Gives a specific, credible reason to talk
tasks.risks: Over-investing in leads that never reply

tasks.name: Log lead with source and status
tasks.description: Create lead record: business, contact person, phone/email, source, date, next action, status
tasks.why: Lead source data shows which channels pay off; prevents double contact
tasks.common_mistakes: Keeping leads only in personal WhatsApp
tasks.if_skipped: Partners contact same lead twice; lost revenue

tasks.name: Referral and partner outreach
tasks.description: Ask past clients, CAs, printers, photographers, marketers for referrals; track referrer
tasks.why: Referrals convert better and cost less

tasks.name: Write personalised outreach message
tasks.description: Draft first message referencing audit findings and a clear next step (15-min call)
tasks.why: Personalised, specific outreach gets replies; generic spam damages reputation
tasks.risks: Spam complaints; WhatsApp account restriction for bulk messaging
tasks.common_mistakes: Copy-paste bulk messages; no call to action

tasks.name: First contact and log outcome
tasks.description: Call/visit/message; record date, channel, who, outcome, next step
tasks.why: Creates the audit trail for who sourced the client
tasks.risks: Disputes between partners about who brought the client

tasks.name: Follow-up sequence
tasks.description: Up to 2–3 spaced follow-ups with added value (example, audit point); stop after no response
tasks.why: Most deals need follow-up; a cap prevents harassment

tasks.name: Share portfolio and case studies
tasks.description: Send 2–3 relevant samples with outcome, scope and price band

tasks.name: Qualification call
tasks.description: 15–30 min call covering need, decision-maker, budget range, timeline, existing assets
tasks.why: Filters out bad-fit and non-paying clients early
tasks.common_mistakes: Skipping budget question; promising features on call

tasks.name: Go/no-go decision
tasks.description: Decide proceed or decline using checklist: budget fit, timeline realism, legal business, red flags; record reason
tasks.risks: Taking every project, including toxic ones

tasks.name: Sales meeting or demo
tasks.description: Present approach, process, timeline, samples; explain payment terms and ownership model upfront
tasks.why: Sets expectations before numbers are discussed

tasks.name: Pricing negotiation
tasks.description: Negotiate by adjusting scope, not just price; record every concession in writing
tasks.why: Discounts without scope change erode margin

tasks.name: Client risk check
tasks.description: Check GSTIN (if B2B), business legitimacy, prohibited content/activities, previous vendor disputes
tasks.common_mistakes: Ignoring red flags due to urgency

tasks.name: Send discovery questionnaire
tasks.description: Send structured questionnaire (see Part 5) via form/doc with deadline
tasks.why: Collects facts before the call; reduces call time

tasks.name: Discovery meeting
tasks.description: 60–90 min structured meeting walking through goals, pages, features, content, accounts, timeline, budget
tasks.common_mistakes: Letting client design the solution on the call

tasks.name: Discovery summary to client
tasks.description: Send written summary of what was understood, open questions, and next steps within 24–48 h
tasks.why: Creates written record client can correct

tasks.name: Identify decision-maker and single point of contact
tasks.description: Record who approves design, content, payments; one SPOC for feedback
tasks.why: Prevents conflicting feedback from multiple people
tasks.risks: Late veto by an unseen owner

tasks.name: Existing assets and accounts audit
tasks.description: Identify current domain registrar and registrant, hosting, email provider, DNS host, analytics, GBP, socials, and who holds logins
tasks.why: Ownership problems block launch; must be found early
tasks.risks: Domain registered in a former vendor's name

tasks.name: Define goals and success metrics
tasks.description: Agree 2–4 measurable goals (e.g., enquiries/month, calls, bookings) and how they will be measured
tasks.why: Guides design priorities and later proves value
tasks.risks: Vague goals lead to subjective acceptance

tasks.name: Draft sitemap and page list
tasks.description: List every page with purpose and priority; mark template vs unique pages
tasks.why: Page count drives price and timeline
tasks.common_mistakes: Not distinguishing templated vs unique pages

tasks.name: Feature list with priorities
tasks.description: List features (forms, booking, blog, gallery, payments, languages) marked Must/Should/Could/Won't
tasks.why: Separates core scope from optional add-ons

tasks.name: Content responsibility matrix
tasks.description: For every page/section: who writes text, supplies images, approves, and by when
tasks.why: Content delays are the most common cause of late projects

tasks.name: Integration and third-party inventory
tasks.description: List every external service (maps, payments, booking, CRM, email), who creates the account, costs, and API limits
tasks.why: Third-party accounts must be in client's name and ready before build

tasks.name: Non-functional requirements
tasks.description: Agree supported browsers/devices, accessibility target, performance targets, languages, hosting region, uptime expectations
tasks.why: These drive testing effort and cost
tasks.risks: Client assumes IE-era or all devices
tasks.if_skipped: Endless 'it looks wrong on my phone' disputes

tasks.name: Requirements sign-off
tasks.description: Client confirms requirements document in writing (e-sign or email 'approved')
tasks.why: Baseline for all later change requests

tasks.name: Write inclusions list
tasks.description: Enumerate exactly what is delivered: pages, templates, features, integrations, content work, rounds, training, warranty days
tasks.why: Clear inclusions prevent 'I thought that was included'

tasks.name: Write exclusions and assumptions
tasks.description: List what is NOT included (copywriting, logo, photos, paid ads, content entry beyond X pages, third-party fees) and assumptions (content supplied by date, one SPOC)
tasks.why: Exclusions carry as much weight as inclusions

tasks.name: Define revision rounds
tasks.description: Specify number of rounds per stage, what a round is (one consolidated list), and what counts as a change request
tasks.why: Unlimited revisions are the top profit killer
tasks.risks: Piecemeal feedback treated as one round

tasks.name: Define client responsibilities and feedback SLAs
tasks.description: Client duties: content, approvals within N working days, account creation, payments; effect of delay on timeline
tasks.why: Client delays must shift deadlines, not your margins

tasks.name: Define milestones and acceptance criteria
tasks.description: Milestones (design, build, UAT, launch) with measurable acceptance tests and deemed-acceptance rule

tasks.name: Bottom-up effort estimate
tasks.description: Estimate each task from the task library with low/high range, add risk buffer (10–25%)

tasks.name: Price calculation
tasks.description: Convert effort to price; add third-party costs (pass-through or client-paid), GST if registered, contingency; set payment split

tasks.name: Prepare proposal
tasks.description: Proposal with problem, solution, scope summary, timeline, price, payment schedule, ownership model, validity date

tasks.name: Formal quotation
tasks.description: Itemised quotation with GSTIN/SAC and tax lines if registered, validity, terms reference
tasks.why: Some clients need a formal quote for internal approval/accounting

tasks.name: Proposal walkthrough
tasks.description: Walk client through proposal; answer questions; log objections

tasks.name: Revise proposal
tasks.description: Update scope/price after negotiation; increment version; mark superseded
tasks.why: Only one current version should exist

tasks.name: Adapt contract template
tasks.description: Start from lawyer-reviewed master services agreement; select project schedule; do not edit core clauses ad hoc
tasks.why: Consistent, reviewed terms reduce legal risk
tasks.risks: Using internet templates with foreign law
tasks.common_mistakes: Changing clauses per client without review

tasks.name: Fill statement of work schedule
tasks.description: Attach scope, milestones, payment schedule, revision policy, timeline, client duties as a schedule to the contract
tasks.why: Keeps legal terms stable and project details specific

tasks.name: IP, ownership and licence check
tasks.description: Confirm clause: what is assigned (in writing, with duration/territory), what is licensed (pre-existing code, libraries, templates), third-party licences, portfolio rights
tasks.why: Indian copyright assignment has statutory formalities; silence creates default rules
tasks.risks: Client assumes payment = ownership of everything incl. your reusable code

tasks.name: Confidentiality and data-processing terms
tasks.description: Add confidentiality; if you will access/process personal data (form leads, customers), add processor-style terms: purpose, security, deletion, breach notice
tasks.why: DPDP Act expects fiduciaries to use processors under a valid contract
tasks.risks: Handling client customer data without terms

tasks.name: Execute contract
tasks.description: Both parties sign (e-sign/wet); store final PDF; record date, version, signatories and authority
tasks.why: A signed contract is the core evidence in any dispute

tasks.name: Stamp duty check
tasks.description: Check applicable state stamp duty for the agreement type/value; pay via e-stamp if required
tasks.why: Unstamped instruments can be inadmissible in evidence until duty and penalty are paid
tasks.common_mistakes: Assuming email contracts never need stamping

tasks.name: Raise advance invoice
tasks.description: Issue invoice for advance (e.g., 30–50%) with correct GST details if registered
tasks.why: Advance funds work and filters non-serious clients

tasks.name: Confirm advance receipt
tasks.description: Match bank credit to invoice; issue receipt/acknowledgement; record TDS if deducted
tasks.why: Work starts only on confirmed funds
tasks.common_mistakes: Trusting screenshots instead of bank credit

tasks.name: Milestone invoices
tasks.description: Invoice each milestone on acceptance or deemed acceptance

tasks.name: TDS tracking and reconciliation
tasks.description: Record TDS deducted by client, check it appears in Form 26AS/AIS, request TDS certificate
tasks.why: You can only claim credit for TDS that is deposited and reported

tasks.name: Payment follow-up
tasks.description: Polite reminders at due date, +7, +14 days; escalate per contract; log each
tasks.why: Late payment is common; a process removes awkwardness

tasks.name: Record project expenses
tasks.description: Record every third-party purchase (theme, plugin, stock image, domain) with bill, payer, reimbursable flag
tasks.why: Expenses affect profit split and client billing

tasks.name: Create project record and folder structure
tasks.description: Create project in tracking app and shared drive with standard folders (01-Contract, 02-Brief, 03-Content, 04-Design, 05-Dev, 06-QA, 07-Launch, 08-Handover, 09-Finance)
tasks.why: Standard structure makes evidence findable and handover easy

tasks.name: Create task board and milestones
tasks.description: Import default tasks from library, delete irrelevant ones, set owners, due dates, milestones
tasks.why: Visible plan avoids forgotten work and supports contribution tracking

tasks.name: Set up client communication channel and rules
tasks.description: Choose official channels (email for decisions, WhatsApp group for quick coordination), response times, working hours, SPOC
tasks.why: Decisions buried in chats cause disputes
tasks.common_mistakes: Taking approvals over voice calls only

tasks.name: Create repository
tasks.description: Create repo (ideally in a business-owned organization or client-owned org), branch protection, README stub, .gitignore excluding secrets
tasks.why: Version control is evidence and safety net
tasks.risks: Repo in personal account hard to transfer

tasks.name: Set up dev and staging environments
tasks.description: Local dev setup, password-protected or noindex staging URL for client review
tasks.why: Client reviews must not be indexed or public
tasks.risks: Staging indexed by Google; client data on public staging

tasks.name: Project credential vault
tasks.description: Create shared vault (password manager) for project credentials with item naming convention
tasks.why: Credentials must never live in chats or docs

tasks.name: Kickoff meeting
tasks.description: Walk through plan, timeline, responsibilities, content deadlines, communication rules, next steps; send notes

tasks.name: Internal task assignment and point pre-estimate
tasks.description: Partners agree owners and default points for each task before work starts; lock the plan
tasks.why: Pre-agreement is the strongest defence against later point disputes
tasks.evidence_expected: App lock record with both confirmations

tasks.name: Weekly progress update
tasks.description: Short written update: done, next, blockers, decisions needed, client actions pending
tasks.why: Keeps client informed and documents delays

tasks.name: Meeting scheduling and agenda
tasks.description: Send invite with agenda, goal, attendees, materials

tasks.name: Meeting notes and action items
tasks.description: Notes within 24 h: decisions, actions with owner and due date, open questions; client asked to correct
tasks.why: Written record of what was decided

tasks.name: Decision log
tasks.description: Maintain log of decisions: date, decision, who approved, source link
tasks.why: Single source of truth for scope decisions

tasks.name: Escalation handling
tasks.description: Handle serious issues (delays, payment, conflict) by call plus written summary with options

tasks.name: Industry and business research
tasks.description: Understand client's services, customer questions, regulatory/professional display norms to confirm with client

tasks.name: Audience and user needs
tasks.description: Define 2–3 audience types, their key questions, devices, languages
tasks.risks: Designing for the client's taste only

tasks.name: Keyword and local search research
tasks.description: Find search terms (service + locality), questions, and competitor terms; map to pages

tasks.name: Technical approach decision record
tasks.description: Decide stack (static, CMS, framework, hosting) with reasons: client skills, budget, maintenance, hosting costs
tasks.risks: Choosing trendy tools client can't maintain

tasks.name: Legal content needs check
tasks.description: List legal pages/disclosures the client must provide (privacy notice, terms, refund policy for e-commerce, grievance contact) and flag for client's lawyer
tasks.why: Legal text is the client's responsibility but must be planned
tasks.risks: Developer drafting legal text as advice

tasks.name: Identify competitors
tasks.description: Choose 3–5 direct/local competitors and 1–2 aspirational ones with client

tasks.name: Competitor site analysis
tasks.description: Review structure, messaging, CTAs, trust signals, pricing display, mobile experience; screenshots

tasks.name: Competitor SEO snapshot
tasks.description: Note titles, key pages, GBP presence, reviews volume

tasks.name: Collect brand assets
tasks.description: Obtain logo (vector SVG/AI/PDF), colours, fonts, brand guide, photo library

tasks.name: Verify brand asset rights
tasks.description: Confirm client owns logo, has licences for fonts/photos they supply; record licence files
tasks.why: You may be publishing infringing material
tasks.risks: Font licences not covering web use

tasks.name: Basic brand guide creation
tasks.description: Define palette, type pairing, logo usage if client has none

tasks.name: Logo design
tasks.description: Logo concepts, refinement, final files and copyright assignment
tasks.why: Logo is a separate creative deliverable

tasks.name: Send content checklist with deadlines
tasks.description: Per page list of required text, images, videos, documents with due dates and format specs

tasks.name: Collect content in shared folder
tasks.description: Receive files in organised folder; reject WhatsApp-compressed images where quality matters

tasks.name: Track content status
tasks.description: Mark each page item: pending/received/edited/approved

tasks.name: Image rights and consent check
tasks.description: Confirm source/licence for each image; photos of identifiable people/customers have consent; stock licence saved
tasks.why: Publishing unlicensed or non-consented images creates liability

tasks.name: Process and optimise media
tasks.description: Crop, resize, compress, convert (WebP/AVIF), rename descriptively, write alt text drafts

tasks.name: Chase missing content and record delays
tasks.description: Remind client per plan; log delay days; notify timeline impact in writing

tasks.name: Homepage copywriting
tasks.description: Write headline, value proposition, sections, CTAs based on research
tasks.why: Homepage drives first impression and conversion

tasks.name: Inner page copywriting
tasks.description: Write service/about/contact/FAQ copy
tasks.common_mistakes: Pricing per project not per page

tasks.name: SEO copy optimisation
tasks.description: Integrate target keywords naturally in headings, intro, titles; avoid stuffing

tasks.name: UI microcopy
tasks.description: Button labels, form hints, error messages, success messages, empty states

tasks.name: Proofread and content approval
tasks.description: Proofread all copy; client approves final text in writing
tasks.why: Client is responsible for factual accuracy of their content

tasks.name: Translation
tasks.description: Translate content to additional language(s) by qualified translator; client review

tasks.name: Key user flows
tasks.description: Map flows for primary tasks (call, enquire, book, buy) from entry to success

tasks.name: Information architecture and navigation
tasks.description: Define navigation labels, hierarchy, footer links, URL structure

tasks.name: Page content hierarchy
tasks.description: For each template define section order and priority

tasks.name: Conversion points and CTAs plan
tasks.description: Place calls, WhatsApp, forms, booking CTAs; define tracking events

tasks.name: Low-fidelity wireframes
tasks.description: Grey-box wireframes, mobile-first, for each unique template
tasks.why: Cheap to change; locks structure before visuals

tasks.name: Wireframe review with client
tasks.description: Walkthrough; collect consolidated feedback

tasks.name: Wireframe revisions
tasks.description: Apply one consolidated round; record approval

tasks.name: Moodboard and style direction
tasks.description: 1–2 visual directions (colour, type, imagery, UI style)

tasks.name: Homepage high-fidelity design
tasks.description: Desktop and mobile designs of homepage with real content

tasks.name: Inner page template designs
tasks.description: Designs for each unique template (service, about, contact, blog list/post, product) desktop+mobile
tasks.common_mistakes: Designing every page instead of templates

tasks.name: Interaction and state designs
tasks.description: Hover, focus, active, disabled, loading, error, success, empty states for components

tasks.name: Design accessibility check
tasks.description: Check contrast (4.5:1 text), target sizes (24px min), focus visibility, not relying on colour alone

tasks.name: Design handoff specification
tasks.description: Export assets, document spacing, breakpoints, component names, interactions

tasks.name: Colour tokens
tasks.description: Define named colour tokens (primary, surface, text, border, states) incl. dark mode if needed

tasks.name: Typography scale
tasks.description: Font families, sizes, weights, line heights for headings/body across breakpoints

tasks.name: Spacing, grid and breakpoints
tasks.description: Spacing scale, container widths, breakpoints

tasks.name: Component library
tasks.description: Buttons, links, inputs, cards, nav, modals, accordions, alerts with variants/states

tasks.name: Icons and image style
tasks.description: Choose licensed icon set and image treatment rules

tasks.name: Design presentation
tasks.description: Present designs explaining rationale tied to goals

tasks.name: Consolidated design feedback
tasks.description: Client sends one consolidated list per round from the decision-maker

tasks.name: Design revision round
tasks.description: Apply agreed changes; classify out-of-scope items as change requests

tasks.name: Written design sign-off
tasks.description: Client approves designs in writing; later visual changes are change requests

tasks.name: Initialize frontend project
tasks.description: Create project with chosen framework/generator, set Node version, scripts (dev/build/preview)

tasks.name: Establish folder structure and conventions
tasks.description: Folders for components, pages, styles, assets, utils; naming rules in README

tasks.name: Configure dependencies and lockfile
tasks.description: Add only needed packages; commit lockfile; record licences
tasks.common_mistakes: Installing heavy libs for small needs

tasks.name: Linting, formatting and pre-commit hooks
tasks.description: Configure linter/formatter and optional pre-commit checks

tasks.name: Global styles and CSS variables
tasks.description: Reset/normalize, CSS custom properties from tokens, base element styles

tasks.name: Typography and font loading
tasks.description: Implement type scale; self-host or optimise web fonts with font-display, subsetting, preload of critical font
tasks.risks: Layout shift from fonts; licence breach

tasks.name: Layout primitives
tasks.description: Containers, grid/flex utilities, section spacing, responsive breakpoints

tasks.name: Header and desktop navigation
tasks.description: Logo, menu, active states, CTA button, skip link
tasks.common_mistakes: No active state; no skip link

tasks.name: Responsive mobile navigation
tasks.description: Accessible menu toggle (button with aria-expanded), focus management, close on Escape, scroll lock
tasks.common_mistakes: Div as button; no Escape close

tasks.name: Footer
tasks.description: Contact details, links, legal pages, social links, copyright line

tasks.name: Build homepage sections
tasks.description: Implement each homepage section from design with real content

tasks.name: Build inner page templates
tasks.description: Implement each approved template and populate pages

tasks.name: Reusable UI components
tasks.description: Buttons, cards, accordions, tabs, modals, carousels (only if needed) with accessible behaviour

tasks.name: Responsive images
tasks.description: srcset/sizes, width/height attributes, lazy-load below fold, eager/priority for hero

tasks.name: Implement form UI
tasks.description: Accessible fields with visible labels, autocomplete attributes, input types, required indicators
tasks.why: Forms are the main conversion point

tasks.name: Client-side validation
tasks.description: Inline validation with clear messages linked via aria-describedby; never the only validation

tasks.name: Loading states
tasks.description: Button disabled/spinner on submit, skeletons for async content, prevent double submit

tasks.name: Error and empty states
tasks.description: Friendly network/server error messages, retry, empty lists

tasks.name: Animations and transitions
tasks.description: Subtle transitions respecting prefers-reduced-motion; no layout-shifting animations

tasks.name: 404 and error pages
tasks.description: Custom 404 with navigation/search; server error page

tasks.name: Favicon, app icons and manifest
tasks.description: Favicon set, apple-touch-icon, theme colour, web manifest if relevant

tasks.name: API integration layer
tasks.description: Central fetch/client module with timeouts, error handling, typed responses
tasks.common_mistakes: Calling third-party APIs with secret keys from browser

tasks.name: Consent banner UI
tasks.description: Consent UI for non-essential cookies/trackers where client chooses to use them; blocks tags until consent
tasks.why: Privacy expectations and DPDP consent principles
tasks.common_mistakes: Banner that doesn't actually block scripts

tasks.name: Print styles
tasks.description: Print stylesheet for menus, price lists, event pages
tasks.why: Some local businesses need printable pages

tasks.name: Frontend tests
tasks.description: Component/unit tests for logic, basic end-to-end for key flows

tasks.name: Initialize backend project
tasks.description: Scaffold server/serverless functions with runtime version, structure, scripts
tasks.common_mistakes: Building custom backend where a service suffices

tasks.name: Environment configuration and secrets
tasks.description: .env.example with names only; secrets in host secret store; separate dev/staging/prod values
tasks.why: Secrets must never be in code or repo

tasks.name: Data models and business logic
tasks.description: Implement entities (leads, bookings, products) and rules

tasks.name: API endpoints
tasks.description: Implement endpoints for forms, content, bookings with consistent responses

tasks.name: Server-side validation and sanitisation
tasks.description: Validate type/length/format of every input; parameterised queries; encode output

tasks.name: Error handling and logging
tasks.description: Central error handler, structured logs without personal data/secrets, correlation IDs

tasks.name: Rate limiting and abuse protection
tasks.description: Limit form/login/API requests per IP/user

tasks.name: File upload handling
tasks.description: Validate type (content not extension), size limits, virus scan if needed, private storage, random names
tasks.why: Uploads are a common attack vector

tasks.name: Scheduled jobs
tasks.description: Cron/scheduled tasks (reminders, cleanup, backups) with monitoring

tasks.name: Backend tests
tasks.description: Unit/integration tests for logic and endpoints incl. auth failures

tasks.name: Choose database and hosting
tasks.description: Select managed DB appropriate to scale/budget; region; backups included

tasks.name: Schema design
tasks.description: Tables/collections, relations, constraints, ERD; data minimisation

tasks.name: Migrations
tasks.description: Versioned migration scripts for schema changes

tasks.name: Seed and test data
tasks.description: Non-personal sample data for dev/staging

tasks.name: Indexes and constraints
tasks.description: Add indexes for queries; unique/foreign keys

tasks.name: Least-privilege database users
tasks.description: App user with only required permissions; separate admin credentials

tasks.name: Backup configuration and restore test
tasks.description: Automated backups with retention; perform one test restore
tasks.why: Backups you haven't restored are assumptions

tasks.name: Authentication strategy
tasks.description: Choose managed auth vs framework auth; define user types; passkey/OTP/password options
tasks.why: Secure login is hard to build from scratch

tasks.name: Signup, login and logout
tasks.description: Implement flows with secure password hashing or provider; generic error messages

tasks.name: Password reset and email verification
tasks.description: Single-use, expiring tokens; rate limited; no password in email

tasks.name: Role-based authorization
tasks.description: Enforce roles/ownership on server for every protected route/object
tasks.why: Broken access control is the top web risk
tasks.common_mistakes: Hiding buttons instead of checking server-side

tasks.name: Session and token security
tasks.description: Secure, HttpOnly, SameSite cookies; expiry; rotation on login; logout invalidation

tasks.name: MFA for admin accounts
tasks.description: Enable MFA/2FA on admin logins (app, platform, CMS)

tasks.name: API contract and documentation
tasks.description: Document endpoints, request/response shapes, errors, auth

tasks.name: Implement and version APIs
tasks.description: Build to contract; version when breaking changes occur

tasks.name: API key scoping and restriction
tasks.description: Restrict keys by domain/IP/API; separate keys per environment; server-side use only for secrets
tasks.why: Stolen keys cause bills and abuse
tasks.common_mistakes: One key for dev and prod

tasks.name: Third-party account ownership check
tasks.description: Confirm each service account is created by/for the client (client email, client billing) with you as invited user
tasks.why: Prevents developer lock-in and billing disputes

tasks.name: Maps integration
tasks.description: Embed map or Maps API with restricted key; correct business location

tasks.name: WhatsApp contact integration
tasks.description: Click-to-chat link with prefilled message, or Business Platform integration if requested
tasks.common_mistakes: Personal number instead of business number

tasks.name: Social media embeds
tasks.description: Links/feeds/embeds with performance and privacy consideration

tasks.name: CRM or email marketing integration
tasks.description: Send leads/subscribers to client's CRM/list with consent recorded

tasks.name: Integration failure handling
tasks.description: Timeouts, retries, fallback (e.g., store lead locally and email) and alerts

tasks.name: Form specification and data minimisation
tasks.description: Define fields, required ones, purpose of each, where data goes, retention

tasks.name: Form submission handling
tasks.description: Deliver to email/DB/CRM reliably; store copy; notify client
tasks.why: Lead delivery is the site's job

tasks.name: Spam protection
tasks.description: Honeypot, rate limit, time-trap, accessible CAPTCHA only if needed

tasks.name: Notice and consent text on forms
tasks.description: Short notice of purpose with link to privacy notice; separate unticked opt-in for marketing

tasks.name: Confirmation and conversion tracking
tasks.description: Success message/thank-you page; fire conversion event

tasks.name: End-to-end form test
tasks.description: Submit every form on staging and production; verify email, storage, auto-reply
tasks.why: Most embarrassing failure is a silent form

tasks.name: Transactional email service setup
tasks.description: Configure sending service in client's account; verify sending domain

tasks.name: SPF, DKIM and DMARC records
tasks.description: Add/merge SPF (one record), DKIM keys, DMARC policy for sending domain

tasks.name: Email templates
tasks.description: Notification and auto-reply templates with plain-text version and business details

tasks.name: Deliverability test
tasks.description: Send tests to Gmail/Outlook/Yahoo; check spam placement and headers

tasks.name: Business mailbox setup
tasks.description: Set up client mailboxes on client's chosen provider; MX records

tasks.name: CMS selection
tasks.description: Choose CMS (none, headless, WordPress, hosted builder) based on who edits and how often

tasks.name: Content model
tasks.description: Define collections/fields/validation for editable content

tasks.name: Editor roles and permissions
tasks.description: Client admin, editor roles; developer account separate and removable

tasks.name: Content entry and migration
tasks.description: Enter/migrate agreed number of pages/items

tasks.name: Plugin/extension vetting and licences
tasks.description: Check maintenance status, security history, licence terms and renewal cost of each plugin
tasks.why: Plugins are a major vulnerability and licence risk

tasks.name: Admin requirements
tasks.description: Define admin tasks, roles, data views, exports

tasks.name: Build admin screens
tasks.description: List/detail/edit screens with server-side authorization

tasks.name: Audit log
tasks.description: Record who changed what and when for admin actions

tasks.name: Data export
tasks.description: CSV export of leads/orders for client
tasks.why: Client owns and uses their data

tasks.name: E-commerce platform decision
tasks.description: Choose hosted platform vs WooCommerce vs custom based on SKUs, budget, maintenance, payment and GST invoicing needs
tasks.why: Custom e-commerce is expensive and risky

tasks.name: Product catalogue setup
tasks.description: Categories, attributes, variants, prices incl./excl. GST, images, stock
tasks.common_mistakes: Unbounded product entry in fixed fee

tasks.name: Cart and checkout
tasks.description: Cart, address, shipping choice, order summary with total price, explicit consent (no pre-ticked boxes)
tasks.why: Core purchase flow; e-commerce rules require clear consent and pricing

tasks.name: Tax display and invoice generation
tasks.description: Show taxes correctly; generate GST-compliant invoices per client's CA instructions
tasks.evidence_expected: Sample invoice reviewed by client's CA

tasks.name: Shipping and delivery rules
tasks.description: Zones, rates, delivery estimates, COD rules if offered

tasks.name: E-commerce mandatory disclosures
tasks.description: Display seller legal name, address, customer care and grievance officer contacts, return/refund/exchange/shipping/payment terms as supplied by client
tasks.why: Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules require prominent disclosures

tasks.name: Order notifications
tasks.description: Customer and admin emails/SMS for order placed/shipped/refunded

tasks.name: Booking tool decision
tasks.description: Choose embedded booking service vs custom based on complexity, payments, reminders

tasks.name: Availability and slots configuration
tasks.description: Services, durations, buffers, staff, holidays, time zone (IST)

tasks.name: Booking confirmations and reminders
tasks.description: Email/SMS/WhatsApp confirmations, reschedule/cancel links

tasks.name: Calendar sync
tasks.description: Two-way sync with client's calendar

tasks.name: Payment gateway account (client-owned)
tasks.description: Client applies and completes KYC with gateway; developer gets restricted team access
tasks.why: Settlements must go to client's bank; KYC is the merchant's obligation

tasks.name: Integrate hosted/tokenised checkout
tasks.description: Use gateway's hosted page or SDK so card data never touches your server

tasks.name: Webhook signature verification and idempotency
tasks.description: Verify webhook signatures; confirm payment server-side; process each event once
tasks.common_mistakes: Trusting redirect URL as proof of payment

tasks.name: Refund and failed-payment flows
tasks.description: Handle failures, pending, refunds and reconciliation

tasks.name: Test-to-live switch
tasks.description: Swap to live keys stored as secrets; small real transaction test and refund

tasks.name: URL structure and slugs
tasks.description: Short, readable, lowercase, hyphenated URLs matching IA

tasks.name: Titles and meta descriptions
tasks.description: Unique title and description per page with brand and location where relevant

tasks.name: Heading hierarchy
tasks.description: One H1 per page, logical H2/H3 nesting

tasks.name: Canonical tags
tasks.description: Self-referencing canonicals; handle www/non-www, trailing slash, parameters

tasks.name: XML sitemap
tasks.description: Auto-generated sitemap with production URLs only

tasks.name: robots.txt and staging noindex
tasks.description: Production robots allows crawling and lists sitemap; staging blocked/noindex + auth

tasks.name: Structured data
tasks.description: LocalBusiness/Organization, breadcrumbs, FAQ/Product where accurate; validate
tasks.common_mistakes: Marking up content not on page

tasks.name: Open Graph and social cards
tasks.description: og:title, og:description, og:image (1200×630), twitter card

tasks.name: Redirect map from old site
tasks.description: Map old URLs to new with 301 redirects; test

tasks.name: Business profile consistency
tasks.description: Ensure name, address, phone match Google Business Profile and site; link website (client-owned profile)

tasks.name: Search Console setup and sitemap submission
tasks.description: Client verifies property (DNS preferred) as owner; developer added as user; submit sitemap

tasks.name: Analytics property in client's account
tasks.description: Create analytics account/property owned by client; developer as property-level user

tasks.name: Install tag with consent handling
tasks.description: Install analytics tag; gate on consent if client adopts consent-based approach

tasks.name: Conversion and event tracking
tasks.description: Track form success, calls (tel: clicks), WhatsApp clicks, bookings, purchases

tasks.name: Verify analytics data
tasks.description: Check real-time/debug data for page views and events on production

tasks.name: Set accessibility target
tasks.description: Agree target (e.g., WCAG 2.2 Level AA for templates and flows built by you) and what is out of scope (client-uploaded content)

tasks.name: Semantic HTML and landmarks
tasks.description: Use header/nav/main/footer, buttons for actions, links for navigation, lists, tables correctly

tasks.name: Keyboard navigation and focus
tasks.description: All interactive elements reachable by Tab, visible focus, logical order, no traps, focus not hidden by sticky headers
tasks.why: Keyboard users and WCAG 2.2 focus criteria

tasks.name: Alt text and media alternatives
tasks.description: Meaningful alt for informative images, empty alt for decorative; captions/transcripts for video

tasks.name: Colour contrast verification
tasks.description: Check text and UI component contrast in built site

tasks.name: Accessible form labels and errors
tasks.description: Labels tied to inputs, error text announced, not colour-only, redundant entry avoided

tasks.name: Automated accessibility scan
tasks.description: Run automated checker on each template; fix issues

tasks.name: Screen reader smoke test
tasks.description: Test key flows with NVDA/VoiceOver/TalkBack: headings, landmarks, forms, menus

tasks.name: Performance budget
tasks.description: Set targets: LCP ≤2.5 s, INP ≤200 ms, CLS ≤0.1, page weight and JS limits

tasks.name: Image optimisation
tasks.description: Modern formats, correct dimensions, compression, CDN

tasks.name: Font optimisation
tasks.description: Subset, preload critical, limit weights, font-display

tasks.name: JavaScript and CSS optimisation
tasks.description: Remove unused code, split bundles, defer non-critical scripts, audit third-party scripts

tasks.name: Caching and CDN
tasks.description: Cache headers for static assets (hashed filenames), compression (Brotli/gzip), CDN

tasks.name: Lab performance test (mobile)
tasks.description: Lighthouse/PageSpeed on mobile profile for key templates; fix major issues
tasks.common_mistakes: Testing only desktop on fast Wi-Fi

tasks.name: Field data review
tasks.description: After traffic accrues, review Core Web Vitals field data (Search Console/CrUX)

tasks.name: Dependency vulnerability audit
tasks.description: Run package audit/scanner; update or replace vulnerable packages

tasks.name: Security headers
tasks.description: HSTS, Content-Security-Policy, X-Content-Type-Options, Referrer-Policy, frame-ancestors, Permissions-Policy

tasks.name: Secrets scan
tasks.description: Scan repo history for keys/passwords; rotate anything found
tasks.common_mistakes: Deleting file but not history/rotating key

tasks.name: Injection and XSS review
tasks.description: Review inputs/outputs; parameterised queries; output encoding; test common payloads

tasks.name: Access control review
tasks.description: Try accessing other users' records, admin routes without auth, changing IDs

tasks.name: Admin protection
tasks.description: MFA, strong unique passwords, login rate limits, remove default accounts, restrict admin by role

tasks.name: File upload security test
tasks.description: Try disallowed types, oversized files, script files, path tricks

tasks.name: Error message and debug review
tasks.description: Debug mode off; no stack traces, versions or paths shown to users

tasks.name: OWASP Top 10 checklist pass
tasks.description: Walk through OWASP Top 10:2025 categories relevant to the site; record status

tasks.name: Real device testing
tasks.description: Test on at least one mid-range Android (Chrome), one iPhone (Safari), one tablet
tasks.if_skipped: Client finds bugs on own phone

tasks.name: Touch targets and orientation
tasks.description: Targets ≥24px (aim 44px), spacing, landscape orientation, zoom not disabled

tasks.name: Browser support matrix
tasks.description: Define supported browsers/versions in scope (latest 2 versions of Chrome, Edge, Firefox, Safari incl. iOS)

tasks.name: Cross-browser testing
tasks.description: Test key pages/flows in each matrix browser

tasks.name: Fix browser-specific issues
tasks.description: Resolve CSS/JS compatibility issues found

tasks.name: Tailor QA test plan
tasks.description: Copy master QA checklist, remove non-applicable items, add project-specific flows

tasks.name: Functional testing
tasks.description: Test every link, button, form, navigation, search/filter, login flows per checklist

tasks.name: Content QA
tasks.description: Spelling, grammar, phone numbers (tap-to-call works), emails, address, prices, hours, social links, legal pages present

tasks.name: Regression testing
tasks.description: Re-run key checks after fixes and before launch

tasks.name: UAT preparation
tasks.description: Prepare staging, test script and feedback template for client acceptance testing

tasks.name: Bug triage
tasks.description: Log each issue with steps, expected/actual, device, severity (blocker/major/minor/cosmetic), classify bug vs change
tasks.why: Prioritises and separates defects from new requests

tasks.name: Fix bugs
tasks.description: Resolve bugs by priority with commit references

tasks.name: Verify and close bugs
tasks.description: Tester (ideally other partner) verifies on staging; closes with evidence

tasks.name: Staging review walkthrough
tasks.description: Walk client through staging site, how to give feedback, deadline for round

tasks.name: Collect consolidated client feedback
tasks.description: One list from decision-maker per round with page, issue, screenshot
tasks.common_mistakes: Accepting WhatsApp voice notes as feedback

tasks.name: Classify feedback
tasks.description: Mark each item: bug (free), in-scope revision (counts toward round), change request (priced)

tasks.name: Revision round 1
tasks.description: Implement in-scope revisions from round 1; send summary of changes

tasks.name: Revision round 2
tasks.description: Final in-scope round

tasks.name: Revision count notice
tasks.description: Tell client when included rounds are used and how further changes are billed

tasks.name: Log change request
tasks.description: Record requested change: description, requester, date, reason, priority

tasks.name: Change impact assessment
tasks.description: Estimate effort, cost, timeline and risk impact; note dependencies

tasks.name: Change order approval and invoice
tasks.description: Client approves CR in writing (price, timeline shift); add to invoice schedule

tasks.name: CI/CD pipeline
tasks.description: Automated build/test/deploy from main branch to staging/prod (host-native or CI)

tasks.name: Production build and environment variables
tasks.description: Set production env vars in host secret store; build with production settings

tasks.name: Deploy to production
tasks.description: Deploy tagged release; record version, time, deployer

tasks.name: Rollback plan
tasks.description: Documented and tested way to revert to previous release and restore DB

tasks.name: Domain registration or ownership confirmation
tasks.description: Domain registered by client (their registrar account, client as registrant) or client confirms existing ownership; record expiry date
tasks.why: Whoever controls the domain controls the website
tasks.evidence_expected: WHOIS/registrar screenshot, invoice in client name
tasks.common_mistakes: Registering in developer's name 'to save time'

tasks.name: Registrar account security
tasks.description: Client enables MFA, registrar lock, auto-renew, valid recovery email/phone

tasks.name: Record renewal dates
tasks.description: Record domain, SSL (if manual), hosting, licence renewals in register and reminders
tasks.why: Renewals are the most forgotten item

tasks.name: DNS record inventory and plan
tasks.description: Export current DNS (MX, TXT, SPF, DKIM, verification, subdomains) before changes; plan new records; lower TTL 24–48 h ahead

tasks.name: DNS cutover
tasks.description: Apply records (A/AAAA/CNAME) in client-controlled DNS

tasks.name: Propagation check and cleanup
tasks.description: Verify from multiple resolvers; restore normal TTL; remove obsolete records
tasks.common_mistakes: Leaving old CNAMEs to deleted services

tasks.name: Hosting selection and sizing
tasks.description: Choose host by stack, traffic, region, backups, support, cost, renewal price

tasks.name: Hosting account in client's name
tasks.description: Client creates account and billing; developer invited as member/collaborator

tasks.name: Server hardening
tasks.description: For VPS: OS updates, firewall, SSH keys only, no root login, fail2ban/equivalent, automatic security updates

tasks.name: TLS certificate issuance and auto-renewal
tasks.description: Issue certificate (host-managed or ACME) for apex and www; confirm auto-renew
tasks.why: HTTPS required by browsers and users

tasks.name: HTTPS and canonical host redirects
tasks.description: 301 HTTP→HTTPS and non-canonical host (www or apex) to canonical; HSTS when stable

tasks.name: Mixed content check
tasks.description: Ensure all assets load over HTTPS

tasks.name: Production configuration review
tasks.description: Debug off, correct env, logging level, error pages, timezone, email sender

tasks.name: Storage permissions
tasks.description: Buckets private by default; public only for public assets; signed URLs for private files

tasks.name: Uptime monitoring
tasks.description: Monitor homepage and key endpoint; alerts to client and/or maintainer
tasks.common_mistakes: Alerts only to developer after handover

tasks.name: Error monitoring
tasks.description: Capture frontend/backend errors with PII scrubbing

tasks.name: Run pre-launch checklist
tasks.description: Complete launch checklist (SEO, forms, analytics, legal pages, redirects, backups, robots)

tasks.name: Final approval and launch window
tasks.description: Client gives written final approval; agree go-live date/time (avoid Friday evening, festivals)

tasks.name: Go-live
tasks.description: Execute deploy + DNS cutover per plan; monitor

tasks.name: Staging lockdown
tasks.description: Ensure staging remains password-protected/noindexed or is taken down

tasks.name: Launch announcement support
tasks.description: Draft announcement post/email/WhatsApp status for client

tasks.name: Production smoke test
tasks.description: Test key pages, navigation, mobile view, HTTPS on live domain

tasks.name: Live forms, emails and payments test
tasks.description: Real submissions and (if applicable) small live payment + refund on production

tasks.name: Indexing check
tasks.description: Submit sitemap, inspect homepage URL in Search Console, confirm no noindex

tasks.name: Post-launch monitoring review
tasks.description: Review errors, uptime, analytics, form deliveries, Search Console coverage over first 7–14 days

tasks.name: Prepare handover package
tasks.description: Assemble docs, account register, licence register, design files, source code access, backups, maintenance options

tasks.name: Handover meeting
tasks.description: Walk through site, accounts, how to get help, what warranty covers, renewals

tasks.name: Handover acknowledgement
tasks.description: Client signs acknowledgement listing items received and access confirmed

tasks.name: Technical README
tasks.description: Setup, build, deploy steps, env var names (not values), architecture, dependencies, known issues
tasks.common_mistakes: Writing it at the last minute

tasks.name: Client user guide
tasks.description: How to edit content, add images, manage forms/leads, common tasks with screenshots

tasks.name: Account and asset register
tasks.description: Every account/service: owner, URL, purpose, who has access, renewal date, cost, where credentials are stored (not the credentials)

tasks.name: Third-party licence register
tasks.description: List fonts, images, icons, themes, plugins, libraries with licence type, licensee, proof, renewal

tasks.name: CMS/admin training session
tasks.description: Live training on content edits and admin tasks; record with consent

tasks.name: Training follow-up
tasks.description: Answer follow-up questions within agreed window

tasks.name: Final invoice
tasks.description: Invoice remaining balance plus approved change orders, less advance

tasks.name: Final payment confirmation
tasks.description: Confirm bank credit, issue receipt, update ledger

tasks.name: Collect TDS certificate
tasks.description: Request TDS certificate for amounts deducted; reconcile with AIS/26AS

tasks.name: Domain control confirmation
tasks.description: Confirm client is registrant and sole account holder; developer removed from registrar; if transfer needed, initiate with auth code (TAC/EPP) securely

tasks.name: Hosting/cloud ownership transfer
tasks.description: Transfer project/team ownership or confirm client-owned account; downgrade/remove developer access

tasks.name: Repository transfer
tasks.description: Transfer repo to client org/account or deliver full archive; confirm client admin; remove developer collaborator if not maintaining

tasks.name: Analytics and Search Console ownership
tasks.description: Confirm client is GA Administrator and verified Search Console owner; remove developer tokens/access or downgrade
tasks.common_mistakes: Removing user but not verification token

tasks.name: Third-party accounts transfer
tasks.description: For each service in register: confirm client owner, billing, API key ownership; transfer anything created by developer

tasks.name: Credential rotation
tasks.description: Rotate all passwords/keys the developer knew: admin, DB, SMTP, API keys, webhooks secrets; update env vars; test

tasks.name: Developer access removal or downgrade
tasks.description: Remove or reduce developer access per maintenance agreement; document what remains and why

tasks.name: Execute copyright assignment/licence
tasks.description: Sign assignment for commissioned deliverables (specifying work, rights, duration, territory, consideration) and licence for pre-existing/reusable components
tasks.why: Indian law requires written signed assignment
tasks.risks: Defaults (5 years/India only) apply if silent

tasks.name: Ownership transfer confirmation
tasks.description: Client signs checklist confirming each item transferred and tested

tasks.name: Maintenance agreement proposal
tasks.description: Offer AMC tiers: updates, backups, monitoring, content edit hours, response times, exclusions, price; separate contract
tasks.why: Maintenance is recurring revenue and clarifies post-launch duties

tasks.name: Monthly updates
tasks.description: Update dependencies/CMS/plugins on staging, test, deploy

tasks.name: Backup verification
tasks.description: Confirm backups ran; quarterly test restore

tasks.name: Monitoring review
tasks.description: Review uptime, errors, security alerts, form delivery

tasks.name: Renewal reminders
tasks.description: Remind client 30/14/7 days before domain, hosting, licence renewals
tasks.common_mistakes: Relying on registrar emails to old addresses

tasks.name: Monthly maintenance report
tasks.description: Summary: updates, uptime, backups, issues, hours used, recommendations

tasks.name: Warranty/defect period support
tasks.description: Fix defects reported within warranty window (e.g., 30 days) that are genuine bugs in delivered work

tasks.name: Support ticket handling
tasks.description: Log requests, classify (defect/AMC/billable), respond within agreed times

tasks.name: Small content edits
tasks.description: Content edits within AMC hours; beyond that billed

tasks.name: Project retrospective
tasks.description: Partners review estimate vs actual, what went well/badly, update templates and default points

tasks.name: Final contribution calculation and sign-off
tasks.description: Freeze tasks/points, resolve open disputes, both partners approve contribution percentages

tasks.name: Profit distribution record
tasks.description: Calculate net profit (revenue − expenses − reserves − taxes set aside), distribute per statement, record payments

tasks.name: Archive project records
tasks.description: Archive contract, approvals, invoices, CRs, handover docs, evidence per retention policy

tasks.name: Testimonial and portfolio permission
tasks.description: Request testimonial/review and written permission to show the work

tasks.name: Close project and revoke internal access
tasks.description: Close tasks, archive board, remove temporary accounts/vault items no longer needed

tasks.name: Privacy notice (client-owned)
tasks.description: Obtain privacy notice from client (ideally lawyer-reviewed) covering what forms/analytics collect, purposes, contact; publish and link
tasks.why: Personal data is collected via forms/analytics; DPDP notice obligations fully apply from May 2027
tasks.risks: Developer-authored legal text treated as advice

tasks.name: Terms of use (client-owned)
tasks.description: Publish client-provided website terms

tasks.name: Cookie/tracker notice
tasks.description: Explain cookies/trackers used; link from consent banner
tasks.common_mistakes: Listing trackers not used or omitting used ones

tasks.name: Refund, cancellation and shipping policies
tasks.description: Publish client-provided policies for e-commerce/paid bookings; link at checkout
tasks.why: E-commerce rules require clear return/refund/delivery info; gateways also require them

tasks.name: Contact and grievance details
tasks.description: Display business legal name, address, contact channels; grievance officer where required

tasks.name: Backup policy and schedule
tasks.description: Define what (files, DB, CMS uploads), how often, retention, where (separate account/region), who restores

tasks.name: Off-site/second copy
tasks.description: Keep a copy outside the primary host, owned by client

tasks.name: Restore drill
tasks.description: Restore to a test environment and verify site works

tasks.name: Language strategy
tasks.description: Decide languages, URL structure (subfolders), language switcher, hreflang, who translates

tasks.name: Implement internationalisation
tasks.description: Translation files/CMS fields, hreflang, lang attributes, Indic font support

tasks.name: Translation QA
tasks.description: Native speaker reviews rendered pages

tasks.name: Project P&L sheet
tasks.description: Track revenue, GST collected (if registered), TDS, expenses, reserves, net profit
tasks.why: Basis for profit split and taxes

tasks.name: Tax records and CA handoff
tasks.description: Provide invoices, expenses, TDS data to CA for GST returns/income tax as applicable

tasks.name: Partner expense reimbursement
tasks.description: Reimburse partner-paid business expenses against bills before profit split
tasks.common_mistakes: Counting expense as both reimbursement and contribution

tasks.name: Contribution dispute review
tasks.description: Structured review of disputed task claims using evidence; decide per dispute rules

tasks.name: Points calibration review
tasks.description: Quarterly compare points vs actual effort across projects; adjust defaults going forward only
